entries.message: "{name}" is not a directive name this will resolve.
entries.fix: A directive name is lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

entries.message: rootDir must be an absolute URL, and "{rootDir}" is not.
entries.fix: Pass import.meta.url — a relative path has nothing to resolve against.
